description: This file defines a graph pattern matching and transformation function that applies the Gumbel max trick in a PyTorch JIT/FX pass. It registers a pattern to identify specific operations involving softmax and exponential functions and transforms the graph accordingly for optimization.

classes.name: Match
classes.description: Represents a pattern match in the computational graph.

methods.name: apply_gumbel_max_trick(match: Match, softmax, rand_exp)
methods.description: Pattern-based transformation that replaces a subgraph involving softmax and exponential functions with a more efficient Gumbel max trick implementation.
